Our HVAC segment offers cooling towers, commercial and industrial refrigeration products, engineered air movement solutions, residential and commercial boilers, and comfort heating systems.

The combination of our leading brands and our focus on innovating to meet our customers’ expanding needs enables us to deliver high-value-added products, across a wide variety of end markets, including commercial, industrial, healthcare, data center, and residential.
View Our Collection of HVAC Brands
Fans Critical Exhaust Dampers Custom Air Handlers
Air-Cooled Condensers Cooling Towers Cooling Tower Parts Evaporative Coolers Industrial Refrigeration Services / Aftermarket
Residential Boilers Commercial / Industrial Boilers Oil Furnaces Water Heaters Industrial Electric Commercial Electric Heat Pumps Vertical Stack Fan Coils

SPX Technologies’ Engineered Air Movement (EAM) business is a leading manufacturer of industrial fans, blowers, critical exhaust systems, dampers and other air movement and air control products. Innovative products, from our Cincinnati Fan, Strobic Air Technologies, Tamco and Daniels Fans brands, give operators and engineers superior-quality, energy-efficient options for a variety of applications. We design, manufacture, sell and service these solutions in the commercial, industrial and institutional markets.
Cincinnati Fans, Daniels Fans, Strobic Air, Tamco
Industrial fans, blowers, critical exhaust systems, dampers and other air movement and air control products.
Visit SPX Engineered Air Movement

Ingenia is a leading North American manufacturer of high-performance air handling units, offering both modular and fully custom solutions. We specialize in serving critical environments such as hospitals, laboratories, educational institutions, food processing facilities, and cultural spaces like museums and symphony halls.
Air handling units, chilled and hot fluid heat transfer coils and silencer products.

SPX Cooling Technologies is a leading global manufacturer of cooling towers, fluid coolers, adiabatic cooling systems, evaporative condensers, industrial evaporators and OEM aftermarket parts from brands that include Marley®, Recold® and SGS Refrigeration. Since 1922, our brands’ cooling systems, components and worldwide technical services have supported applications in heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC), refrigeration, and industrial process cooling.
Cooling towers, evaporative fluid coolers, evaporative condensers and air cooled heat exchangers.

Weil-McLain® is a leading North American brand of hydronic comfort heating systems for residential, commercial and institutional buildings, since 1881. Contractors, engineers, architects, homeowners and facility managers rely on Weil-McLain boilers for their comfort heating needs. Installed in homes, offices, schools, restaurants, hotels and other facilities throughout North America, the Weil-McLain brand is among the most trusted and often used in the building industry.
Residential boilers, commercial boilers, heat pump systems and indirect fired water heaters.

Marley Engineered Products manufactures supplemental heating solutions trusted by architects, engineers, contractors, and homeowners. With over 40 years of expertise, our diverse range of electrical heating products meets the heating and ventilation needs of commercial, industrial, and residential spaces. Committed to customer satisfaction and energy efficiency, Marley delivers comfort and lasting value.
Reliability. Efficiency. Innovation. Patterson-Kelley provides the industry with dependable, high-efficiency commercial heating solutions.
Commercial boilers, water heaters and control systems.

Products from Williamson-Thermoflo are used in numerous residential and light commercial applications throughout North America. Service is available through licensed plumbers, professional HVAC contractors, oil dealers and installers.
Residential boilers, furnaces, commercial heating and air conditioning products.

Sigma offers value-added solutions to designers, builders and contractors. Our success is the result of consistent product innovation to meet adapting industry, regulatory and customer needs. The Sigma product offering includes a wide variety of Hydronic Heating, Vertical Stack Heating & Cooling, and commercial indoor DX cooling equipment.
Hydronic heating, vertical stack heating & cooling, and commercial indoor DX cooling equipment.

Omega Heat Pump provides all in one heating and cooling solutions for residential and commercial applications. Omega continues to expand its product offering to meet the rigorous requirements for green, quiet and comfortable heating and cooling. Omega Heat Pump has products covering a wide spectrum of applications including vertical stack water source heat pumps, vertical stack hybrid heating & cooling, and replacement chassis heat pumps.
Vertical stack water source heat pumps, vertical stack hybrid heating and cooling, and replacement chassis heat pumps.

ASPEQ Heating Group is the strategic accumulation of high quality electric heater manufacturers for the Industrial, Commercial and Military/Marine industries. Each add-on acquisition has provided additional sales channels, new customers, expanded product scope to meet customer needs, and design capabilities previously unavailable to our other brands. As applications convert from legacy heating systems (steam or natural gas-fired) to electric, we are better equipped than ever before to provide the right recommendation. Complimentary technologies provide value to end-users who need numerous application solutions.
Accutherm, Banner Day, BBC, Brasch, Heatrex, Indeeco, Solar Products, Spectrum
Electric heaters for the industrial, commercial, marine and military industries.

pages.raw_title: Commitment to Ethics and Compliance - SPX Technologies in Charlotte, NC
pages.raw_meta: SPX Technologies is committed to ethical conduct and legal compliance across all operations. Its robust ethics program, including a mandatory Code of Conduct and anonymous reporting via the EthicsPoint hotline, promotes integrity, accountability, and transparency at every level.
raw_blocks: Home > Our Company > Ethics and Compliance
Commitment to Ethics and Compliance

SPX Technologies is committed to high standards of ethics and integrity in all of its business operations and expects that all its employees, officers, and directors will comply with the word and spirit of every applicable law or regulation in the countries and localities in which we operate.
SPX Technologies maintains a world-class compliance and ethics program designed to ensure that its employees are aware of and adhere to applicable laws and ethical standards.
On August 28, 2018, SPX adopted a new Code of Ethics and Business Conduct to which all SPX employees, officers, and directors are required to adhere.

SPX Technologies has contracted with EthicsPoint, Inc., to provide a hotline service, independent of SPX, dedicated to receiving any report of a violation or potential violation of these principles. The EthicsPoint Hotline enables anyone making a report to do so confidentially and anonymously via the internet or telephone.

In addition, SPX Technologies conducts investigations of these reports in a confidential and discreet fashion and prohibits any act of retaliation against employees reporting compliance concerns in good faith. To make a report, go to www.ethicspoint.com and follow the instruction for “Making a Report” or call 1-866-ETHICSP (1-866-384-4277) or 1-866-737-6850 outside the United States and Canada.
Download the French language version here.
At SPX, our values of Integrity, Accountability, Excellence, Teamwork and Results are core elements that drive the way we engage with each other, our customers, our partners and the community.
Since 1912, the brands that make up SPX Technologies have been designing and manufacturing quality products serving several rapidly developing industries.
With more than $2 billion in annual revenue and over 6,000 employees in 16 countries, SPX offers a wide array of highly engineered infrastructure products with strong brands.
SPX products and services are designed to help meet the needs of an expanding world and help solve the complex issues companies face in growing their businesses.
